[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3157,"var":"c","code":"if (c != 3 && c != 1 && c != 4) return stbi__err(\"bad component count\",\"Corrupt JPEG\");","note":"The CMYK frame is accepted, so the decoder proceeds with attacker-controlled component geometry."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3184,"var":"z->img_comp[i].v","code":"if (z->img_comp[i].v > v_max) v_max = z->img_comp[i].v;","note":"The maximum vertical sampling factor is derived from the supplied file, which influences the later resample selection."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3207,"var":"z->img_comp[i].w2","code":"z->img_comp[i].w2 = z->img_mcu_x * z->img_comp[i].h * 8;","note":"The decoder expands the component width into MCU-sized storage based on the parsed sampling factors."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3762,"var":"r->w_lores","code":"r->w_lores = (z->s->img_x + r->hs-1) / r->hs;","note":"For a large image width, the low-resolution width remains large, increasing the number of resampler iterations and the amount of written output."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3769,"var":"r->resample","code":"else if (r->hs == 2 && r->vs == 2) r->resample = z->resample_row_hv_2_kernel;","note":"A 2x2 sampling ratio selects the HV special-case kernel, which expands each low-resolution sample into four output pixels."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__resample_row_hv_2","line":3375,"var":"out[i*2-1]","code":"out[i*2-1] = stbi__div16(3*t0 + t1 + 8);","note":"The HV resampler emits multiple output pixels per input sample; if the upstream geometry underestimates the destination row size, these indexed writes can run past the end of the buffer."}
]
JSON
